name: AS Widgets – Custom Card for Elementor
author: asfaan

sections.description:
Custom Card Widget for Elementor adds a flexible card widget to the Elementor editor.

The widget includes:

  • Image control
  • Name/title field
  • Description field
  • Button text and link controls
  • Border radius control
  • Background color control
  • Typography controls
  • Border and box shadow controls
  • Responsive image height settings

This plugin is useful for creating profile cards, service cards, team member cards, feature cards, and call-to-action cards directly inside Elementor.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor.
